program_name: Gender, Women and Sexuality Studies, BA

programme_facts.value: Gain a deeper understanding of feminist thought and investigate the social construction of gender, race and sexuality through interdisciplinary training. Through a curriculum that integrates critical thinking, problem-solving and research skills, you'll be equipped with tools to work in a wide variety of occupations.
